notes: Frozen BEFORE any predictions on aivai-private-seed-v1.
Do not edit this file after baseline run; create prompts-v2 for later experiments.
UNCLEAR is intentionally omitted from visual candidate prompts; handled by metric policy.
OTHER included for classifier contract; dataset support may be zero.

prompts.CAR_SALE: a marketplace listing photo of a complete passenger car, SUV, crossover, or minivan for sale
prompts.AUTO_PARTS: a marketplace listing photo of a car spare part such as an engine, bumper, headlight, wheel, tire, rim, or battery
prompts.TRUCK_TRANSPORT: a marketplace listing photo of a complete truck, tractor unit, dump truck, or heavy goods vehicle for sale
prompts.SPECIAL_MACHINERY: a marketplace listing photo of construction or industrial special machinery such as an excavator, loader, crane, or bulldozer
prompts.MOTORCYCLES: a marketplace listing photo of a motorcycle, scooter, moped, or ATV for sale
prompts.WATER_TRANSPORT: a marketplace listing photo of a boat, motorboat, jet ski, or other watercraft for sale
prompts.BUSES: a marketplace listing photo of a passenger bus or passenger minibus for sale
prompts.COMMERCIAL_TRANSPORT: a marketplace listing photo of a commercial van or light commercial vehicle for business use
prompts.REAL_ESTATE: a marketplace listing photo of real estate such as an apartment, house, commercial premises, or land plot
prompts.OTHER: a marketplace listing photo of a consumer product that is not a vehicle, vehicle part, special machinery, or real estate
